ACCEPTANCE VERIFIED INDEPENDENTLY. example_fmri_effects() is implemented, exported, and delivers more than this bead asked for. Tested against the live working tree.

  returns   fit, domain, frame, contrast, model_rdm, truth
  truth     planted_features, planted_feature_ids, signal_measurements,
            contrast_pattern, condition_patterns, noise_sd, seed
  shape     245 features, 4 partitions, 245 frame nodes, 19 planted features,
            57 signal measurements, noise_sd 0.6, seed 20260814

IT RETURNS A FIT, NOT A BARE RELATION, which is better than I specified - the error channel is present, so the same fixture reaches lm_relation_fit-only capabilities including the analytic sampling covariance. It also avoids the rMVPA anti-pattern I warned about: no unwrapping needed, the components go straight into the workflow.

TRUTH IS RECOVERABLE, which was the one property I pressed for and which rMVPA's generator lacks:

  mean total INSIDE  signal measurements   1.3314
  mean total OUTSIDE                      -0.0001
  argmax total is a signal measurement     TRUE

THE DECOMPOSITION SEPARATES AS THE DOCS CLAIM, on the shipped fixture:

  inside    coherent 0.3606   configuration 0.9708     multivariate-dominant, as a
                                                       planted pattern should be
  outside   coherent -0.0000  configuration -0.0001

AND THE NEGATIVE-RETENTION ARGUMENT IS NOW DEMONSTRABLE FROM THE SHIPPED FIXTURE:

  54.8 percent of outside-region total estimates are below zero

That independently reproduces the 52.4 percent I measured in a pure-null simulation on bd-01KZYP5CXFSXFV6HS65Y99CT4X, using the package's own data rather than mine. The 'why negative values are not a bug' vignette that bd-01KZYARD5697TRN2Q3S0E153BM asks for can now be written from example_fmri_effects() alone, in three lines, with no simulation code in the vignette.

rsa() works with the shipped model_rdm - coefficient 4.2201 at the planted peak.

I am not closing this bead since it is a child of the p0 slice and disposition belongs to whoever is running that. Recording the acceptance evidence.
